name: Pixel It
tagline: Turn a photo into pixel art on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Drop a picture, or take one with the camera. Drag the block size. Tick greyscale if you want a game-boy look, or pick a colour palette from the list. The canvas updates on this device — the picture never leaves it.

The last conversion comes back the next time you open the app, still only here. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere.

This is a converter, not a drawing app: you start from a photo. An unofficial port of Pixel It by giventofly.
